english.title: Cause / permit vehicle other than a hackney carriage to wait at a hackney carriage stand without reasonable excuse
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, caused or permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE VEHICLE..), which was not a hackney carriage, to wait on a stand for hackney carriages at **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD AND LOCATION..) at **(..SPECIFY THE TIME..), during a period for which that stand had been appointed or deemed to have been appointed by the **(..SPECIFY THE DISTRICT COUNCIL..) under the provisions of section 63 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 64(3) and 76 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.

english.notes: (i) In any proceedings under this section against the driver of a public service vehicle, it shall be a defence to show that, by reason of obstruction to traffic or for other compelling reason, he caused his vehicle to wait on a stand or part thereof and that he caused or permitted his vehicle so to wait only for so long as was reasonably necessary for the taking up or setting down of passengers - section 64(4)
